title: AI FOMO Index: an open dataset and index of AI-news activity
description:
AI FOMO Index is an open research project that tracks the changing pace of the AI information environment. It combines news velocity, AI lab activity, community attention and topic spikes into a transparent, reproducible index.

This archive is a snapshot of the repository: the dataset under data/ (one record per AI-news item, plus a machine-readable index, dedup ledger and per-source coverage), the collection pipeline and the index method. Records are generated; points, coverage and historical reconstructions can be revised between versions.

The index describes changes in a selected AI-news corpus. It does not measure technological progress, human anxiety, personal relevance or real-world impact. No independent validation or peer-review status is claimed.

Licensing: the dataset under data/ is CC BY 4.0; the source code is MIT.
